verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI and a REST API that let administrators script installation, configuration, connections, and data export (for example, billing or session-log collection). However, any automation has to be built and run by the user through external batch scripts, deployment tools, or third-party systems. These are developer building blocks, not a first-party feature for setting up autonomous background automations. Nothing in the pack documents a built-in scheduler, workflow engine, or agentic automation running inside AnyDesk.
